Important: ========= The DB used for populating fault word must order faults with the highest priority faults at the top to the lowest at the bottom. In addition, the faults shall be grouped consecutively by type with Level 1 or Major Fault at the top and Level 2 faults below. The first fault number is to associated with the DB address of DBX0.0, the ninth with DBX1.0, etc.
See the Memory Map Implementation Guide for a complete fault word implementation description and list of requirements.
